name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-vi-the-decisive-battle
title: Final Fantasy VI - The Decisive Battle
description:
Iconic music from Final Fantasy - ported as close to the original including original samples as possible.

This music would be suitable for boss battles or castle level but to each their own.

Echo has been reduced slightly to account for insertion size. Additionally only uses 7 channels to completely free up at least one of the SFX channels so it can be used in more areas. Channel 7 (#6) has been reduced in volume slightly to be less apparent when missing when other SFX's take up the channel.
